input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation is imposed on Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement. The grant in § 2 is a non-exclusive licence in our favour (a limit on the licence scope, not an exclusive-dealing covenant); § 3 (Restrictions on Use) contains only standard copying, assignment and reverse-engineering limits; § 10 (Maintenance) and § 11 (Fees) do not require Sparkling to source maintenance, support or any other products solely from Garman or to refrain from procuring from third parties. The only other "exclusive" references are the exclusive-remedy clause in § 15 and non-exclusive jurisdiction in § 20(h), neither of which is a restrictive covenant. This meets the preferred position: we retain full freedom to buy from other suppliers.
